ModName.English: Return to the Orient Test Silver Slots (do not ship)

Description.English: TEST ONLY: every mine slot the Orient map generator can fill becomes a silver ore deposit (all 83 mountain mining positions: large 10/9, medium 7, small 4), to check how the silver deposit sits on every position. Only affects an Orient session generated while this is active: start a new game, or open the Orient for the first time.
